params.body:
## What

**A member personalises their week, rather than saying where they work.** "Tell us where you work" read like an employee profile. Research platforms name this setting after what it does, a personalised feed (CB Insights, Statista), and ask about the work, not the person. The title of the page is already "This week", so the card says what happens to it.

| | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|
| Card heading | Tell us where you work | Personalise your week |
| Card text | Name your organisation and pick the sectors, generations and markets that matter to it. Your week then starts with your sectors, and Ask answers for your organisation. | Pick the sectors, generations and markets you work on, and say what your organisation does. Your week then starts with your sectors, and Ask answers with that in mind. |
| Button | Tell us about your organisation | Personalise your week |
| Form heading | Your organisation | Personalise your week |
| Form text | Your Overview starts with the sectors you pick, and Ask answers for your organisation. | Your week starts with the sectors you pick, and Ask answers with all of this in mind. |
| First field | Name | Organisation |
| Panel heading, no name yet | Your organisation | Your sectors |
| Panel, sectors from sign-up only | Add your organisation and what it does, and Ask answers for it. | Add who you want to reach and what your organisation does, and Ask answers with it in mind. |
| Panel link, sectors from sign-up only | Add your organisation | Add more |
| Toast after removing | Your organisation is removed. | Removed. Your week is no longer personalised. |

These stay as they were:

- "Sectors you work in", the same question sign-up asks;
- the title "This week for Noorderbank" once an organisation is named;
- Ask's suggested questions ("What does this week mean for Noorderbank?").

Wording only: nothing changes in what is stored or sent.

## Checked

- `e2e/overview.spec.js` follows the new words. **Full e2e run: 84 of 84.**
- The lint ratchet is at its ceiling, and the build passes.
- Seen in a browser with production data of 28 October: the card, and the form filled in.
